assets.caption: The scene is a university campus, captured in a realistic style, showcasing a blend of historic architecture and modern landscaping. The overall tone is academic and tranquil, with clear skies and a sense of order. The central courtyard features a gravel ground, meticulously maintained, with various parts of the brick building forming its perimeter. The building itself is characterized by its light yellow brick and distinct red and white striped banding, with numerous large, arched windows featuring dark frames that reflect the sky and surrounding structures. Some sections of the building are adorned with ornate architectural details, including classical columns, decorative cornices, and arched entrances with stone surrounds. Modern elements like sleek metal bike racks are integrated into the landscape, contrasting with the traditional brickwork. Trees with autumnal leaves are scattered around the edges of the courtyard, adding a touch of natural beauty and seasonal color, and beyond the main building, glimpses of other contemporary structures and more foliage are visible under the clear blue sky. The brick building extends in a U-shape around the gravel courtyard, with its various wings and facades forming the enclosed space. The bike racks are positioned in the foreground of one wing of the building, while the trees are located towards the outer perimeter of the courtyard, providing shade and visual interest. The ornate entrances are strategically placed along different facades, serving as prominent entry points into the institution. The 360 scene is faultless.
